title: Comparatives and the Language of Quantity

groups.instructions: Choose the correct option to complete each sentence.

questions.prompt: There were ______ cars on the road in 2020 than in 2019.
questions.explanation: 'Fewer' is used with plural countable nouns (cars). 'Less' is used with uncountable nouns.

questions.prompt: The ______ of people who cycle to work has doubled.
questions.explanation: Use 'the number of' with countable nouns such as people, and 'the amount of' with uncountable nouns such as water or money.

questions.prompt: Spending on food was ______ higher in Japan than in Brazil.
questions.explanation: To make a comparative stronger, use much, far or considerably, not 'very'.

questions.prompt: Rail travel is twice ______ popular as air travel in this region.
questions.explanation: Multiples use the pattern twice / three times as + adjective + as.

questions.prompt: The ______ amount of rainfall was recorded in July.
questions.explanation: One-syllable adjectives form the superlative with -est: the lowest.

questions.prompt: Only ______ students chose to study philosophy, so the course was cancelled.
questions.explanation: 'A few' goes with plural countable nouns. 'A little', 'much' and 'a great deal of' go with uncountable nouns.

questions.prompt: The more people use public transport, ______ traffic there will be.
questions.explanation: The double comparative is 'the more ..., the less ...'. 'Traffic' is uncountable, so 'less' is correct.

questions.prompt: Exactly half of the respondents preferred online shopping. In other words, ______ of them did.
questions.explanation: Half equals 50 per cent. 'The majority' means more than half, and 'a minority' means less than half.

questions.prompt: Coffee consumption in Finland is ______ in Italy.
questions.explanation: When comparing like with like, repeat the noun with 'that' (singular) or 'those' (plural): consumption in Finland vs. consumption (that) in Italy.

groups.instructions: Complete each sentence with ONE WORD ONLY.

questions.prompt: Prices in 2024 were almost the same {{10}} in 2023.
The figure for women was slightly lower {{11}} the figure for men.
There was very {{12}} change in the number of visitors between May and June.
questions.explanation: 'Change' is uncountable here, and 'very little' means almost none.

questions.prompt: Sales in the north were not {{13}} high as sales in the south.
questions.explanation: The negative comparison is 'not as/so + adjective + as'.
